data.title: 角楯花凛 · 都会街角的运动便服等待
data.description: 周末喧闹的学园都市林荫街角，微风拂动行道树叶洒下斑驳光影。花凛身着深灰无袖短连帽衫与牛仔短裤，小麦色马甲线与修长健美的大长腿一览无余。她单手握着易拉罐冰咖啡倚靠在行道树旁，远远看到赶来的老师，熔金色的眼眸顿时浮现出安心的笑意。
data.location: sunny city street corner under green tree shade
data.action: 她单手握着易拉罐冰咖啡倚靠在行道树旁，远远看到赶来的老师，熔金色的眼眸顿时浮现出安心的笑意
data.lighting: dappled sunlight through tree foliage onto tanned skin
data.promptProse: Leaning casually with one shoulder against a leafy sidewalk tree at a sunny weekend city corner, Karin wears her relaxed grey sleeveless cropped hoodie and distressed denim shorts. Holding a chilled can of iced coffee lightly in one hand, she brightens into a warm, relieved smile the moment she spots the viewer hurrying toward her. Bright dappled sunlight filters through the green leaves across the sunlit pavement and her dark skin.
data.animaCaption: Leaning against a tree-lined city corner in her sleeveless cropped grey hoodie and denim shorts, Karin holds a cold can of iced coffee and greets the approaching viewer with a warm smile. Dappled daylight filters through green foliage across the sunny street.
